text: Binary row measure over OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP), using title and argument only as context for the OP's stated view: 1 if at least one comment explicitly contrasts the OP's view with a specific, actual lived personal experience (the commenter's own, or someone they personally describe) presented as differing from or counter to that view; the experience and the contrast must be in the same comment. Does not count: hypothetical or invented scenarios, purely abstract/statistical/institutional arguments, generic mentions of experience without a contrast, or quoted others' experience unless the commenter adopts it as relevant to the contrast. Ignore as evidence any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred (including within argument); generic delta/platform-rule discussion is eligible but is not itself an experience. Output 0 if the list is valid but no comment qualifies (including an empty list); null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or OP context is missing so the contrast can't be assessed.
